# allofus.one

> allofus.one is a free social network for adults 18+, built in Denver, Colorado. The feed shows posts newest first by default, with no hidden ranking algorithm. Members get a personal page, free Brand pages for businesses, communities called Constellations, live chat Rooms, free video calls, a private LIFEboard for goals and habits, and an optional 3D world that also works in VR headsets, all on one account in the web browser.

## Key facts
- Adults 18+ only. Sign-up asks for a date of birth, and every member does a one-time selfie age check that runs on their own device (the picture is not uploaded). Accounts flagged as under 18 are held until a person reviews them.
- Feed order is the member's choice: New (newest first, no ranking, the default), Top (most reactions and comments) or Hot (the published Reddit formula). Each option is explained on screen.
- Safety: posts, comments, rooms and Global Match listings are screened for slurs and harassment; every post, comment, message and profile can be reported to a human moderation queue; child-safety reports go to NCMEC. Adults and minors can never message, connect or call.
- Ads: rare, labeled Sponsored, reviewed by a person, never targeted by tracking (only city, the Constellation being read and pages followed). Every ad has "Why this ad?", "Hide ads like this" and "Turn ads off".
- Free: membership, the feed, your page, Brand pages, Constellations, Rooms, Unity Call video, Global Match, Glimmers, the LIFEboard and the 3D world. Paid: LIFEspark Lift marketing packages and ad placements for businesses.
- Your data: download everything you posted as one file, or delete your account yourself from the Control panel.
- allofus.one never holds or touches money that members send each other and takes no cut; Creators Corner tips go straight to the creator's own Venmo, PayPal or Cash App.
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638 · 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204.

## Main pages
- https://allofus.one/ : the feed (app; needs JavaScript)
- https://allofus.one/about/ : what allofus.one is, who it is for, the rules and an FAQ
- https://allofus.one/mission/ : the founder's mission and story
- https://allofus.one/constellations/ : communities, twelve genres, the ten buy, sell, trade and free boards
- https://allofus.one/chat/ : Rooms, live text chat
- https://allofus.one/match/ : Global Match, "I need / I have" matching for items and services
- https://allofus.one/meet/ : Unity Call, free browser video calls for up to six people
- https://allofus.one/rooms/ : the Global Room, a virtual meeting space (flat, 3D or VR)
- https://allofus.one/glimmers/ : Glimmers, camera faces and backdrops for photos and 10-second clips, on device
- https://allofus.one/world/ : the 3D world (VR: /world/?vr=1)
- https://allofus.one/games/ : our browser worlds plus a short list of free browser games
- https://allofus.one/creators/ : Creators Corner, keep 100% of fan tips; free tools at /creators/tools/
- https://allofus.one/lift/ : LIFEspark Lift, the marketing hub for businesses
- https://allofus.one/follow-badge/ : allofus.one icons and follow badges for your website
- https://allofus.one/updates/ : what is new, dated, newest first
- https://allofus.one/community-rules/ · /terms/ · /privacy/ · /accessibility/

## App views (JavaScript)
- /?v=board LIFEboard · /?v=brand Brand pages · /?v=groups Constellations in the feed · /?v=events Events · /?v=courses Courses · /?v=dm Messages · /?v=panel Control panel

## Lantern Guides

- [Lantern Guides](https://allofus.one/guides/): Plain guides to a social life you control: feeds, privacy, safety and your data, with every number sourced.
- [An adults-only social network: how age checks and reports work](https://allofus.one/guides/adults-only-social-network/): How an 18+ social network keeps minors out: a private date of birth, a one-time on-device selfie age check, human-read reports, and the honest limits.
- [Chronological vs ranked feeds: what changes when no algorithm picks your posts](https://allofus.one/guides/chronological-feed-vs-algorithm/): What really changes day to day when no algorithm picks your posts: what you gain, what you lose, and how to make a newest-first feed work for you.
- [How to download your social media data before you leave a platform](https://allofus.one/guides/download-your-social-media-data/): Step-by-step: download your data from Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube before you leave, what each export includes, and how to keep it safe.
- [Social media you control: a plain-English checklist](https://allofus.one/guides/social-media-you-control-checklist/): Ten questions that show whether a social network gives you real control: your feed, your data, ads, messages, safety and leaving. Use it on any app.
